Billions App Prototype
BILLIONS/Home

Sections

Tap the bottom bar inside the phone to move between tabs. Profile opens from the avatar on Home; Search opens from the search buttons. Long-press any blank area in the phone for that section’s phases and states. Each section keeps its place while you move around.

Detailed prototypes

Personas, flow lists and state controls for each section.

Release phases

Taken from each section’s own prototype. Sections without phase controls look the same in every phase.
